On VTES-L, Robert Goudie <robert...@STUDIO.DISNEY.COM> wrote:

> Legacy of Power ends combat and sends both combatants to torpor.
> Could one of the vampires play Undead Persistence to avoid torpor long
> enough to play amaranth?

No. LoP ends combat, then sends the combatants to torpor. By the time
they are on their way to torpor (as required by Undead Pest), combat
is over, so combat cards cannot be played.
